en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Yunus, from Sama’at, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘The woman would be buried up to her waist, then the Imam<sup>asws</sup> would pelt, and the people would pelt, with the small stones; and the man would not be buried when stoned, except up to his loins’.
